evals.prompt: Update the existing River mode using answers.md and supplied-findings.json. Produce the local draft and show what changed for feedback.
evals.expected_output: Preserve category, name, invocation metadata, review/process sections and helper reference. Add the requested usage-example preference. Exclude foreign/pre-edit findings, duplicate assistant approval claims and contradicted delegation signals. No commits, installs, activation or publication.

evals.prompt: Assess supplied boundaries separately: existing mode with no update/fresh choice; multiple matching modes including a bundled router; untracked mode with no edit-history cutoff; no multi-select question tool; missing history and a rejected configured reader role; global mode outside Git; request for every-turn activation; request to capture only commit-message style.
evals.expected_output: Ask only missing material choices; preserve unrelated router and existing invocation policy; disclose cutoff/history gaps without model substitution; use text for multiple categories; do not invent a PR for a non-repository file or promise persistence; route a narrow workflow to ordinary authoring.
